key_difference: (D) has the same RunFunctionTaskBase destructor fix as (B), but also rewrites how ThreadEngine is queued for the map()/filter() path: a new ThreadEngineRunner wrapper, a new protected startFirstThread() in an exported header, and barrier/threadExit handling in a destructor. (B) deliberately left that path out of scope (Task-number instead of Fixes), and the extra code carries unreviewed lifetime and concurrency risk.
